question: Which of the following is an example of a vector quantity?
solution:
The correct answer is **Velocity.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The definition of a **vector quantity** is a physical quantity that has both **magnitude **and **direction**.
 
• The fact that **velocity** has both **magnitude** and direction makes it a **vector quantity**.
 
• The **concept** of velocity is used to describe the speed </str
